title: No Travel Origin, Safety (arrival delay code 03, late positioning due to upline mechanical/safety), APPR, Basic Aeroplan
description:
A single-leg flight is delayed more than 3 hours by arrival delay code 03. The inbound aircraft arrived late after an unscheduled maintenance fix upline, which falls under Safety. The customer chose not to travel and stayed at the origin. Under APPR, Safety is its own category, separate from controllable and uncontrollable, and it never pays cash compensation. Checks that DDS classifies code 03 as Safety and returns NE-14, and that the customer's linked Aeroplan Basic profile (tier A) is shown but doesn't change the outcome.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC065: one adult passenger, �mile Gagnon. One AC domestic leg: AC 470, YUL?YYZ, May 31, 2026. Scheduled 10:00 ? 12:00. Actual departure 14:15 (255 min late). Actual arrival 16:20 (260 min late). Status: DELAYED (operated). Cancellation code: NONE. First arrival delay code 03 (UM). First departure delay code 03 (UM). Inbound aircraft rotation: AC 409 YYZ?YUL, delayed by TN43 maintenance (not on the customer's PNR). Passenger not boarded, coupon not flown. Customer stayed at YUL. No Travel status: Origin. No rebooking accepted. Aeroplan: linked, tier code A (Aeroplan Basic). No expense receipts. Fallback: FALSE. Regime: APPR. More than 72 hours have passed. Filed within 366 days.
